synopsis: ISO 19014-3 addresses environmental qualification and minimum environmental tests for safety-related electrical/electronic components, including vibration, temperature and electrical robustness [f662, f2470]. The booklet treats component laboratory testing as highly mature for heavy off-road applications and includes Part 3 qualification in the lifecycle of a brake-commanding collision-avoidance function [f1022, f2338]. However, component environmental qualification does not establish camera, lidar or radar perception-chain performance across visibility and weather combinations, leaving the perception-performance question open [f2471, f2907]. ISO 16001:2017 references ISO 15998 for environmental conditions but permits ISO 19014-3 as an alternative [f2345]. As of 1 October 2026, the published edition remained 2018; Edition 2 had its FDIS registered on 5 February 2026, reached stage 60.00 on 22 August 2026, and was scheduled for October publication [f2322, f2323]. The forthcoming ISO 19014 Parts 1–5 texts were unavailable for review, so their final content remained uncertain despite the reported publication schedule [f2862].
